description: Official baseline, original codebook/manual and final source universe were not available to this worker; the unit remains provisional pending coordinator baseline review.
required_followup: Coordinator checks the official baseline and coding manual before integration or final inclusion.

description: Open-web search is not LexisNexis and does not establish complete event coverage. Searches covered English and Khmer generic/weekly terms and targeted land, labor, forest and activist-release topics, but open-web indexing remains uneven.
required_followup: Coordinator or reviewer considers any available systematic archive sources and retains an explicit non-exhaustive scope statement.

description: Khmer-language searches returned noisy, mostly unrelated results; no independent native-language review of the retrieved search results was available. RFA’s event reporting was in an English translation attributed to its Khmer Service.
required_followup: Review Khmer-language source leads and transliterations with language expertise if available; do not infer complete local coverage from the searches.

description: The 16 February Prek Lavea protest has no reported attendance count. The ten land-dispute families and the dozens of police are not protester turnout.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous attendance evidence and clarify whether the action involved at least 50 participants.

description: The 16 February article documents a land dispute with a private landholder and prior local-authority actions but does not specify a government-directed demand at the protest.
required_followup: Find direct evidence of the protesters’ demand and target, or keep eligibility pending_state_target.

description: On 23 February, RFA reports 10–20 participants at each of 11 community locations. Each site is below 50; the report’s campaign framing does not by itself resolve whether the dataset unit aggregates dispersed sites. No campaign-wide total is calculated.
required_followup: Coordinator reviews event-unit and threshold treatment while preserving each published site count.

description: Each provisional action is supported by one opened contemporary news article only: CamboJA for 16 February and RFA for 23 February. The Sithi chronology does not report the 23 February action; it is selected retrospective context, not contrary evidence.
required_followup: Search for independent contemporaneous coverage and preserve agency/origin distinctions; do not count the RFA English version as an independent translation source.

description: CCHR retrospective report retrieval returned a web-tool Internal Error; ordinary HTTPS fallback failed DNS before an HTTP response. These are technical failures, not denials, and the report remains search_only. ODC labor-profile material is also unresolved: a prior unit review says its blocked original was not reopened, so this unit made no body request. One CamboJA receipt deferred during concurrent corpus changes and was replaced by a fresh stable receipt before opening.
required_followup: Review technical/source-access limitations; do not treat failed requests or search snippets as body evidence.

description: For the 16 February event, arrests of 11 are reported, but the relation of a separate police-violence allegation to that event is unclear; accommodation, beatings, dispersal, killings, shootings and ignore remain unknown. For 23 February, all seven response values remain unknown; failure to obtain comment is not coded as ignore.
required_followup: Seek event-specific contemporaneous reporting for state response and alleged violence; preserve unknowns without inferring from silence.

description: Neither event has a verified physical end date. The February 23 article describes future step-by-step campaigning but does not establish when later actions happened or when the campaign ended; no February continuation from January was substantiated.
required_followup: Search immediate pre/post-month records and event follow-up; keep end dates null until physical closure evidence exists.
